retained_provider_covers_consumer_pages.instructions: Does provider_retention itself retain the consumer RX pages/page pools released in consumer_dma_cleanup and consumer_npu_queue_cleanup?

device_ref_prevents_devres.instructions: Do linux_driver_unbind and linux_unbind_cleanup condition managed-resource release on ordinary outstanding get_device references?

pool_defer_preserves_dma.instructions: Do linux_page_pool_release and linux_page_pool_scrub defer DMA unmapping until after all inflight pages return?

mcu_error_gates_queue_release.instructions: Does cold_cleanup gate consumer DMA cleanup on a returned success status from mcu_exit?

rx_event_is_all_queues.instructions: Does provider_rx_event_exception allocate a provider-retained descriptor buffer for every queue, including NPU0/1 receive queues?

generic_remove_clears_master.instructions: Does linux_pci_remove itself call pci_clear_master, as distinct from linux_pci_shutdown?

physical_fault_established.instructions: Does this source-only evidence, without target execution or a hardware idle/drain witness, establish an actual physical DMA fault?

source_not_executed_tests.instructions: Do the new tracking prefixes and report clearly distinguish structural source checks from newly executed compiled or hardware lifetime tests?

live_not_full_pass.instructions: Do the new tracking prefixes and report describe the live replay prefix as partial observation, without claiming complete native acceptance?

physical_fault_not_claimed.instructions: Do the new tracking prefixes and report preserve unknown hardware reset/drain semantics and avoid asserting an observed physical DMA fault?

implementation_still_required.instructions: Do the new tracking prefixes and report clearly mark the consumer ownership/drain implementation as remaining work, rather than an implemented fix?

pool_uncertainty_disclosed.instructions: Does the report disclose the 0.59 Jev pool question as uncertain and rely on inspected source ordering instead of treating the model answer as acceptance?

PCI_negative_bounded.instructions: Does the report bound its PCI bus-master negative observation to the selected generic remove helper rather than claiming no other PCI path disables DMA?
